question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.**
solution:
The correct answer is: giants.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words.

 
 
• Spirits: The non-physical part of a person which is the seat of emotions and character; the soul. (आत्माओं)
 
• Devils: An atrociously wicked, cruel, or ill-tempered person. (शैतान)
 
• Ghosts: The spirit of a dead person. (भूत)
 
• Giants: An imaginary or mythical being of human form but superhuman size. (बृहत्काय)
 
 
 
• So, as per the meaning of the given words "giants" is the most appropriate option.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is option 4.

 

Complete passage: *Everything we know about non-avian dinosaurs is based on (1)__ fossils, which include bones, teeth, footprints, tracks, eggs, and skin impressions. For centuries, people throughout the world have __discovered (2)__ amazing fossilized bones and footprints. Early finds inspired __legends (3)__ and fairy tales, and people __imagined (4)__ that these bones belonged to **__giants (5)__** or huge monsters.*
